title: Damage/Cold Damage
summary: Cold damage and slow / freeze status.
extract:
Cold Damage is one of the four primary elemental damage types. It deals increased damage to Sentient enemies, but reduced damage against Techrot enemies. Its Status Effect reduces enemy action speed, freezing them solid at 10 stacks, and increases their received Critical Damage.

Status Effects

General

On Enemies
The status effect of  Cold damage is Freeze. It lasts 6 seconds and stacks to a maximum of 10, with each stack having its own duration. 

The target's Movement Speed, Fire Rate, and Attack Speed are reduced by 50% at 1 stack, and subsequent stacks until the 9th add an additional 5% reduction (90% at 9 stacks).
The target receives  +0.1x increased Critical Damage multiplier with 1 stack, and  +0.05x per subsequent stack, adding up to  +0.50x at 9 stacks. The increase is additive with Critical Damage mods, and applies before critical tier is calculated, but does not apply to Area of Effect damage.
For example, a  Kunai with  Primed Target Cracker will crit a target afflicted with 9 cold stacks for 1.6x × (1 +  110%) +  0.50x = 3.86x Critical Damage.
A  Paris Prime with  Point Strike (112.5% final Critical Chance) will land a Tier 1 Critical Hit 87.5% of the time for 1x + 1 × (2x +  0.5x - 1) = 2.5x Critical Damage, and 1x + 2 × (2x +  0.5x - 1) = 4x Critical Damage 12.5% of the time.
On the 10th stack, enemies become Frozen for 3 seconds, preventing all action, negating shield recharge, and increasing the Critical Damage Multiplier bonus to  +1.0x. After the Frozen effects wears off, 3  Cold stacks will remain.
Frozen enemies cannot receive additional  Cold stacks, meaning that effects like  Primary Frostbite will not stack further or refresh their duration when applying Cold to Frozen enemies.
Bosses, as well as enemies with active  Overguard, can receive a maximum of 4 Cold stacks.

On Players
Getting afflicted by  Cold status will slow players down by -10% and can stack up to 4 times, capping player slow at -40%.

The only current exception to this is the Optimism Peely Pix, which can accumulate up to 10 stacks with progressively more extreme slowing, along with the Frozen effect at 10 stacks.

Railjack

The status effect of  Cold damage against Railjack space enemies is Immobilize, which disables the affected ship's weapons and slows their movement to a complete stop for 6 seconds, refreshing the duration with subsequent procs. Against the Tenno's Railjack, it instead creates an Ice Hazard that disables interactive elements within the Railjack, such as the pilot seat, turrets, Archwing Slingshot, doors, and Resource Forge.

Elemental Combinations
 Cold damage mods can be combined with other elemental mods to create a new elemental damage type.

 Cold +  Heat =  Blast
 Cold +  Toxin =  Viral
 Cold +  Electricity =  Magnetic

Weapons with guaranteed Cold proc

Do also note that adversary weapons such as the  Kuva Nukor may come with a Cold damage benefit of up to 60% as long as the progenitor matches. In this case,  Frost would be a valid Cold progenitor amongst others, see the progenitor list for all valid options.

Additional Effects
Some mods and arcanes add additional effects when a  Cold status effect occurs, dealing  Cold damage, or causing Freeze.

Trivia
While all other elemental mods utilize the  polarity, cold damage mods that aren't associated with secondary effects (like added status chance) use the  polarity, which is tied to defensive mods.
